correctness.rationale: The RSD-to-coupon equality follows from exactly matching finite transition kernels, while the DA-to-coupon correspondence is pathwise for any fixed independent priorities. Joint unenvied probabilities telescope to r!/prod(n-i_s+s); factorial moment asymptotics yield Exp(1) by a determinate moment problem. Verified independently via exact rational integral expansion, exhaustive mechanism enumeration and all fixed priority patterns for three schools.

value.rationale: Identifies a structural distributional equivalence between two canonical school-choice procedures, not merely a shared average. The complete finite law permits exact probability calculations, and the mean-one exponential limit shows fluctuations of order log n, a substantively different policy inference from knowing E[U_n]=H_n.
